main_text.p: significatione altera, Part. מִתְפַּלְחָן Diffecant se, Jobi 39.6. Pahel פַּלַח Servire, colere, operari. Item Servire, Laborare facere, Esth.1.11. Aphel אַפְלַח Servire facere, Servitute imponere. Syr. Part. ܡܦܠܚܢ Qui militat, 1.ad Corinth.9.7.
פַּלְחָא Ch. Fragmen, Segmentum, Jobi 41.15. Plur. פַּלְחֵי וַלְדָא Sectiones uteri, Exo.34.19. in T.H.
פּוּלְחָנָא Ch. & Syr. Cultus, cultura, servitus, ministerium, opus, operatio, labor.
פַּלְחָא Ch. ܦܠܚܢ Syr. Colens, Cultor terrae, Agricola, Vinitor. Plur. פַּלְחֵי, פַּלְחִין, ܦܠܚܝܢ.
ܦܠܚܢ Syr. Miles. Plur. ܦܠܚܝܢ, ܦܠܚܝܢ.
פְּלַט Ch. Evomere, exspuere, ejicere: Item Evadere, eripi, liberari. Pahel פַּלֵּט Ch. & Syr. Exspuere, ejicere, Fut. וְלָא יִפַּלֵּט Neque ejicit, sc. semen frustra, Jobi 21.10. Eripere, liberare.
פְּלַטְיָא Ch. Platea. Plur. mafc. פְּלַטְיָא & foemin. פְּלַטְיִן, Num.22.39. in Jon. פְּלַטָּן, פְּלַטִיָּת Psal.144.14. Genef.42.6. in Jon.
פְּלַטְיוּתָא Ch. Idem, Psal.55.11. Item Latitudo, amplitudo. Aff.Græc. πλατὺς, Latus, amplus.
פְּלָטִין Ch. Palatium, palatia. Usurpatur singulariter & pluraliter.

page.notes: Several Syriac and Hebrew-letter forms are printed in a mixed or pointed style and were difficult to read exactly; the Syriac words are approximated and marked as printed in the scan. Hebrew vocalisation marks are partly uncertain.
